messages:
Marta V: Aurora Slate reached out for a short scoped perf/W validation. They want clear watt vs throughput curves, tail latency, and a kernel flags matrix they can reproduce for marketplace collateral.

Owen R: i'll handle the bench harness and make sure outputs are CSV + ndjson traces. which model and seq len do they want?

Marta V: they asked for prism-13b at seq 768 and batches [1,2,4]. two quant modes: q8 and q4_0. power caps: 60/80/100W.

Chen L: ops notes: pin BIOS v2026-02-20 and microcode. we'll run 8 nodes (2 vendor control, 6 test). capture inlet/rack temps and RAPL + NVML.

Zara D: i'll prepare the partner one-pager draft. Aurora wants a single headline metric (delta_Throughput@80W) but also full curves and reproducibility appendix.

Owen R: draft harness: ```bash
./bench --model prism-13b --seq 768 --batches 1,2,4 --quant q8,q4_0 \
  --power-cap 60,80,100 --kernel-sets stock,memprefetch,latency_tuned \
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 200 \
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/aurora-slate/<run>/ --trace ndjson
```

Marta V: include per-step token timings and KV-cache hit ratio in the traces. Aurora wants plots with watts on x-axis and throughput + p95 on y-axis (two panels).

Chen L: bench-bot can schedule Wed 09:00 UTC. we'll also capture kernel dmesg and perf maps.

bench-bot: scheduled aurora-slate-20260602-01 across 8 nodes starting 2026-06-02T09:00:00Z. live logs -> https://bench.redwood.internal/aurora-slate/aurora-slate-20260602-01

Owen R: provisioning done. control nodes set to vendor-kernel-5.19.5. pinned p-states to avoid DVFS noise.

bench-bot: job aurora-slate-20260602-01/2 finished: batch=2 quant=q4_0 power_cap=80 avg_watt=79.3 throughput=14.1 p50=19.8 p95=47.6 kv_hit=0.91. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/aurora-slate/aurora-slate-20260602-01/results/part-0002.jsonl

Owen R: early signal: latency_tuned kernel tightens p95 by ~9% at 80W and yields +5% throughput vs stock. will run bootstrap CI and aggregate across nodes.

Zara D: great. i'll start drafting the one-pager but will hold headline claim until stats are final and legal signs off.

Chen L: FYI node-5 showed higher inlet temp; excluding it from first aggregate and scheduling a retest on spare.

bench-bot: job aurora-slate-20260602-01/6 failed (node-5): thermal throttling events. dmesg -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/aurora-slate/aurora-slate-20260602-01/node-5-dmesg.log

Owen R: rerunning that config on spare now. will post final aggregates + delta_Throughput@80W (95% CI) when ready.

Marta V: thanks team. action items: Owen (final stats + artifacts), Zara (one-pager draft + reproducibility appendix), Chen (node retest & temp validation). scheduling partner review for Thu 15:00 UTC.

bench-bot: run aurora-slate-20260602-01 completed. final artifacts: s3://redwood-partner-bench/aurora-slate/aurora-slate-20260602-01/final.zip
